Welcome aboard.|Niya and her coworker|audio=Niya-Coworker-OneYearLater.flac|}} A [[human]] '''employee''' of [[Sienar Fleet Systems]] worked in [[Sienar Test Facility 73]] on the [[planet]] designated [[73]]{{Databank|sienar-test-facility|Sienar Test Facility}} during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[4 BBY]], she passed by the facility's commissary{{Andor|One Year Later}} {{AD|Disney+}} when her coworker [[Niya]]—who was assigned to the upkeep of the secretive [[TIE Avenger prototype|TIE Avenger]] prototype{{Databank|niya|Niya}}—called out to her from inside. Niya was accompanied by a [[Gender|man]] that the coworker did not recognize, and Niya introduced him as a new test [[pilot]], although in reality he was [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], a member of the rebel [[Axis network]] who Niya had helped infiltrate the facility in order to [[Theft of the TIE Avenger prototype|steal]] the prototype [[starfighter]]. The coworker welcomed Andor and then whispered to Niya that he was cute before leaving. Andor then questioned Niya about what the coworker had whispered before successfully stealing the TIE Avenger. The coworker had light skin and [[Color|brown]] [[hair]]. Like Niya, she wore an orange and white [[jumpsuit]], a black [[belt]] and black [[boot]]s, and carried a [[datapad]]. ==Behind the scenes== The character was portrayed by [[Chanel Waddock]] in "[[One Year Later]]," the first episode of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']], which was released on [[Disney+]] on [[April 22]], [[2025]],{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} and was credited only as "Niya's coworker". Her casting had been previously revealed on Waddock's listing on the website of their talent agency.{{WebCite|url=https://theartistspartnership.co.uk/artist/chanel-waddock|text=CHANEL WADDOCK|archivedate=20250309131050}} ==Appearances== *{{Andor|One Year Later}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Niya's coworker|imagecat=Images of Niya's coworker}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Collègue de Niya non-identifiée |ka=ნაიას თანამშრომელი }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]] [[Category:Sienar Fleet Systems employees]]
